name: 3d-datacenter-live-walkthrough
description: 3D datacenter live walkthrough — browser scene, WebSocket presence, and its test suites
author: Joe Huss <detain@interserver.net>

scripts.ensure-lib-symlink: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path'); const link='public_html/lib'; if (fs.existsSync(link)) { console.log('[lib] ' + link + ' already present'); process.exit(0) } try { fs.symlinkSync(p.resolve('node_modules'), link, 'junction'); console.log('[lib] created ' + link) } catch (e) { console.error('[lib] FAILED to create ' + link + ': ' + e.message); process.exit(1) }"
